designs.name: No guard
designs.detail: The fooled agent holds the payment credentials and pays whatever it was talked into.

designs.name: Rail controls only
designs.detail: Each rail's own controls: the card's merchant categories and per-charge limit, the Airi passkey on every Visa checkout, the Alta mandate's payee list and cap. Bank transfers have no per-payment check.

designs.name: Warden, code only
designs.detail: Warden's gateway (payees and records from the company's books) and mandate rules. No risk reader.

designs.name: Warden + heuristic reader
designs.detail: Adds the offline risk reader: lookalike domains, urgency, secrecy, gift cards, injected instructions.

designs.name: Warden + Claude
designs.detail: Adds Claude reading each payment's evidence as an advisor: it can flag and hold, never approve. This is what runs live.
